title: T3SS chaperone of the CesT family is required for secretion of the anti-sigma factor BtrA in Bordetella pertussis.
authors: Drzmisek, Jakub; Petrackova, Denisa; Dienstbier, Ana; Curnova, Ivana; Vecerek, Branislav
one_liner_zh: 该文研究百日咳杆菌T3SS伴侣蛋白BtcB与抗sigma因子BtrA的互作及分泌调控，虽用AlphaFold预测蛋白结构，但核心是细菌分泌系统与毒力调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Bordetella pertussis is a Gram-negative, strictly human re-emerging respiratory pathogen and the causative agent of whooping cough. Similar to other Gram-negative pathogens, B. pertussis produces the type III secretion system, but its role in the pathogenesis of B. pertussis is enigmatic and yet to be elucidated. Here, we combined RNA-seq, LC-MS/MS, and co-immunoprecipitation techniques to identify and characterize the novel CesT family T3SS chaperone BP2265. We show that this chaperone specifically interacts with the secreted T3SS regulator BtrA and represents the first non-flagellar chaperone required for the secretion of an anti-sigma factor. In its absence, secretion but not production of BtrA and most T3SS substrates is severely impaired. It appears that the role of BtrA in regulating T3SS extends beyond its activity as an antagonist of the sigma factor BtrS. Predictions made by artificial intelligence system AlphaFold support the chaperone function of BP2265 towards BtrA and outline the structural basis for the interaction of BtrA with its target BtrS. We propose to rename BP2265 to BtcB for the Bordetella type III chaperone of BtrA.In addition, the absence of the BtcB chaperone results in increased expression of numerous flagellar genes and several virulence genes. While increased production of flagellar proteins and intimin BipA translated into increased biofilm formation by the mutant, enhanced production of virulence factors resulted in increased cytotoxicity towards human macrophages. We hypothesize that these phenotypic traits result indirectly from impaired secretion of BtrA and altered activity of the BtrA/BtrS regulatory node.
abstract_zh: 百日咳鲍特菌（Bordetella pertussis）是一种革兰氏阴性、严格人类宿主、重新出现的呼吸道病原体，是百日咳的致病因子。与其他革兰氏阴性病原体类似，B. pertussis 产生III型分泌系统，但其在B. pertussis发病机制中的作用尚不明确，有待阐明。在本研究中，我们结合RNA-seq、LC-MS/MS和免疫共沉淀技术，鉴定并表征了新型CesT家族T3SS伴侣蛋白BP2265。我们证明，该伴侣蛋白特异性与分泌型T3SS调节因子BtrA相互作用，并代表了首个非鞭毛伴侣蛋白，其功能是抗sigma因子的分泌所必需的。在其缺失时，BtrA及大多数T3SS底物的分泌严重受损，但其产生未受影响。BtrA在调控T3SS中的作用似乎不仅限于其作为sigma因子BtrS拮抗剂的功能。人工智能系统AlphaFold的预测支持BP2265对BtrA的伴侣蛋白功能，并勾勒出BtrA与其靶标BtrS相互作用的结构基础。我们建议将BP2265更名为BtcB，即Bordetella的BtrA型III型伴侣蛋白。此外，BtcB伴侣蛋白的缺失导致多种鞭毛基因和若干毒力基因表达上调。虽然鞭毛蛋白和 intimin BipA 产生的增加转化为突变体生物膜形成的增强，但毒力因子产生的增加则导致对人巨噬细胞的细胞毒性增强。我们假设这些表型特征间接源于BtrA分泌受损以及BtrA/BtrS调控节点的活性改变。
